prompt:
Subject: A footnote at the bottom of a page.

Composition: Show a reader pointing to a small block of fine unreadable print beneath a short horizontal rule at the bottom of an open book page. A tiny asterisk connects it to a matching asterisk within the main text above, without readable words.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. Allow only the two matching asterisks as essential footnote markers; render all print as unreadable strokes. No words, numerals, speech balloons, logos or watermark.
For each human: exactly two naturally attached arms and two hands, with no duplicate limbs.
en: A footnote appears beneath the main text at the bottom of the open page.
ja: 開いた本のページ下部に、本文に対応する脚注が載っています。
